SELECT usernum, name, officenum, email, team, level, user_status
		FROM user
		WHERE 1 = 1
		 
		 
		 
		 
			 
					AND usernum LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
				 
		 
		ORDER BY FIELD(team, '임원', '개발', '경영지원', '디자인'), level_num, usernum
		LIMIT ?, 10
